tips.title: Export Tips
tips.body:
• PDF format is best for job applications
• US Letter is common in North America
• A4 is standard in Europe and most other countries
• Always proofread before sending

wizard.title: Build with AI
wizard.heroSubtitleSeeded: We started a draft from your answers. Replace the [brackets] with your details, then generate.
wizard.heroSubtitle: Type or paste a paragraph or two about your role, experience, and skills. The AI will turn it into a structured resume you can edit and download.
wizard.examplesLabel: Stuck? Load an example, then swap in your own details
wizard.inputPlaceholder: I've been a [role] for [n] years. Currently at [company] doing [main work]. Before that I [previous role]. I'm strong in [tools/skills]...

readiness.ok: Good, a bit more would help

blocked.brackets: Replace the [bracketed] parts with your own details — the AI will write about whatever is in the box.
blocked.template: This is still our example. Swap in your own roles, companies and skills so the resume comes out as yours.

wizard.hintsTitle: Add these and the resume gets noticeably better

hint.detail: Write a few more sentences — the more you give it, the better the resume
hint.employer: Name the companies or organisations you worked for
hint.numbers: Add a number — team size, years, budget, growth, anything measurable
hint.skills: List your top skills or tools
hint.education: Mention your degree, training or certifications

wizard.weakResult: There wasn't much for the AI to work with, so this resume is nearly empty. Going back and adding a couple of sentences will change it completely.

you.title: Who are you?
you.subtitle: Just the basics — this goes at the top of your resume.

work.title: Where do you work?
work.subtitle: Your most recent job. You can add older ones after.

highlights.title: What do you do there?
highlights.subtitle: A sentence or two is plenty. Numbers make it much stronger.

skills.title: What are you good at?
skills.subtitle: Tap the ones that apply. Add your own if we missed any.

education.title: Any education or training?
education.subtitle: Optional — skip it if it doesn't apply to you.

guided.noJobYet: I haven't had a job yet
guided.noExperienceNote: No job yet — no problem. Skip ahead and we'll build your resume around your skills and education instead.

prompts.daily: What did you do day to day?
prompts.improved: What did you improve or fix?
prompts.led: Did you lead, train or manage anyone?
prompts.numbers: Any numbers? People, money, volume, time saved

guided.highlightsPlaceholder: I look after 30 patients a shift, trained 5 new nurses, and handle the ward roster.
guided.educationPlaceholder: I have a BSc in Nursing from Punjab University, finished in 2021.
guided.switchToFreeText: I'd rather just write about myself

missing.identity: Add your name or the job you want first — we need something to put at the top.
missing.substance: Add a job, a skill or your education so there is something to build from.
